thread:
Maya (support): @team NimbusRetail just flagged a ~$18k spike on invoice 2026-03 that doesn’t match their dashboard. Customer says tokens in UI ~120k but invoice shows 1.2M. Link: https://app.redwood.example/invoices/NR-2026-03
Leo (cs): putting customer contact on thread, they shared sample request IDs and time range. They need provisional credit while we investigate :eyes:
Aisha (finance): please include ledger IDs and suggest provisional credit amount. We need revrec note if we refund.
Ravi (billing-eng): looking at ingestion for account nimbus-retail, initial scan shows a replay of usage events between 2026-03-08T02:00Z-02:12Z. Suspicious pattern: same request_ids with different ingestion_ids.
Jules (infra): pulling raw event stream logs from s3 region-eu-1, snippet: `2026-03-08T02:01:07Z account=nimbus request_id=abc123 ingest_id=xx1 status=ok` then `2026-03-08T02:01:08Z account=nimbus request_id=abc123 ingest_id=yy2 status=ok` — looks like duplicate ingestion across failover job.
Maya (support): customer says they saw a reconnect during streaming at 02:01 and retried, SDK version 0.9.2. They sent us the client logs showing reconnects.
Ravi (billing-eng): hypothesis: SDK sent both 'stream_end' partial token events and a final 'complete' event after reconnect, and our dedupe relied on `ingest_id` which was regenerated on retry — idempotency key mismatch. Repro steps I ran locally with SDK 0.9.2: `python repro_stream_double_count.py --reconnect --send-final` produced duplicate token entries.
Jules (infra): root cause: failover worker that replays failed deliveries wasn't including the original `client_idempotency_key` in replay payloads; it generated new ingest_id, so billing pipeline considered them new events. Patch in flight to include `client_idempotency_key` and drop duplicates at ingestion. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proc/commit/7c9f2a8
billing-bot: Ledger summary for account=nimbus-retail between 2026-03-08 and 2026-03-09: recorded_tokens=1,205,412 dashboard_tokens=120,138 discrepancy=1,085,274
Aisha (finance): propose provisional credit of $16,200 pending full audit (matches our unit pricing calc). We'll need a revrec memo: "Provisional refund issued for duplicate ingested usage due to ingestion replay idempotency mismatch; final adjustment pending audit." Add ticket FIN-2026-594.
Leo (cs): notified customer that provisional credit is issued and we're investigating root cause. They asked for ETA on final refund.
Ravi (billing-eng): ETA: patch merged to canary in eu-1 now, full rollout across regions by 2026-03-09 18:00Z. I'll provide a precise list of affected ingest_ids for auditing.
Jules (infra): mitigation in place: replay job now preserves `client_idempotency_key` and we reran dedupe job for the time window; dedupe removed ~1,082,000 duplicate token events from ledger snapshot (preliminary).
Aisha (finance): once dedupe finalizes, we'll post final credit and update revrec note. For now provisional credit applied to invoice NR-2026-03, ledger ref FIN-2026-594-P.
Maya (support): thanks all. @Ravi please drop the list of affected ledger IDs and I’ll attach to the support ticket. I'll also schedule a short postmortem with cs + billing + infra. :calendar:
Ravi (billing-eng): will upload CSV to the ticket by EOD 2026-03-09.
Maya (support): closing the customer-facing loop for now. Will re-open if any follow-ups from NimbusRetail.
